This was the first ceremony in which the awards were titled the "Actor Awards". The name change was announced on November 14, 2025. Per the official website, the "changing [of] its name [is] to better reflect its true spirit and position as the only industry honor given to actors, by actors".{{efn|Attributed to multiple references:{{cite web |url=https://variety.com/2025/tv/news/sag-awards-renamed-the-actor-awards-1236582268/ |title=SAG Awards Changes Name to 'The Actor Awards' Starting Next Year |last=Schneider |first=Michael |work=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |date=November 14, 2025 |access-date=February 28, 2026 |archive-date=February 11, 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260211072416/https://variety.com/2025/tv/news/sag-awards-renamed-the-actor-awards-1236582268/ |url-status=live}}{{cite web |url=https://www.actorawards.org/newname |title=The Actor Awards Presented by SAG-AFTRA FAQ |publisher=[[Actor Awards]] |access-date=February 28, 2026 |archive-date=December 14, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251214175001/https://www.actorawards.org/newname |url-status=live}}{{cite magazine |url=https://ew.com/sag-awards-shock-with-new-name-change-ahead-of-2026-ceremony-11850037 |title=SAG Awards shock with generic, unexpected name change: 'A new chapter' |last=Nolfi |first=Joey |magazine=[[Entertainment Weekly]] |date=November 14, 2025 |access-date=February 28, 2026}}}} [[Evan Funke]] served as executive chef for the event.{{cite web |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/lifestyle/lifestyle-news/the-actor-awards-netflix-ceremony-chef-evan-funke-1236501646/ |title=Evan Funke Named Executive Chef for Actor Awards |last=Gardner |first=Chris |work=[[The Hollywood Reporter]] |date=February 11, 2026 |access-date=February 28, 2026 |archive-date=February 14, 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260214040552/https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/lifestyle/lifestyle-news/the-actor-awards-netflix-ceremony-chef-evan-funke-1236501646/ |url-status=live}} ==Winners and nominees== [[File:Michael B Jordan - Sinners (cropped).jpg|right|thumb|150px|[[Michael B.
